progress.description: We document the park's progress phase by phase. Review construction updates, site photography and development milestones, with the transparency a decision of this scale deserves.

phase1.title: INDUSTRIAL PARK INFRASTRUCTURE
phase1.text: Roadways, utilities, storm drainage, lighting and access points.

phase2.title: LAND PARCEL SITE WORK
phase2.text: Preparation, grading and utility connection for each land parcel.

phase3.title: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
phase3.text: From foundation to completion of each building.

phase4.title: DELIVERY OF FINISHED SPACES
phase4.text: Fit-outs and tenant improvements for each operation.
